facts.text: Pine Grove first appeared on maps as the Pine Grove House, a lodging inn that became the town’s first post office in 1856.
A town hall was erected in 1877 on donated land, marking the formal establishment of Pine Grove as a township under federal law.
Unlike many nearby communities, Pine Grove never incorporated and has remained under Amador County’s jurisdiction ever since.
The town’s location near the High Sierra and Carson Pass made it a popular spot for early miners and loggers seeking easy access to lakes and rivers.
At 2,400 feet, Pine Grove sits where oak and pine trees mingle, and a light dusting of snow falls each year.
Just an hour from Kirkwood Ski Resort, Pine Grove offers family restaurants, cafes, and a range of shops for visitors and locals alike.
